guarantees.claim: fifo_wdata.strb is first set to all zeros, then for each byte lane i from 0 to OutWidth/8-1, strb[i] is driven to packer_wmask[8*i]. Any bits beyond OutWidth/8-1 remain 0.

assumptions.claim: Parameter OutWidth is a positive integer multiple of 8, so the loop bound covers all byte lanes correctly.
assumptions.cond: when data path width is defined by OutWidth
assumptions.risk: If OutWidth is not a multiple of 8, some byte lane strobe bits may be undriven, potentially causing spurious writes or data corruption.

assumptions.claim: Input packer_wmask has a width of at least OutWidth bits, so the index 8*i is within bounds for all i in the loop.
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds access may cause simulation errors or unpredictable hardware behavior.

uncertain_points.claim: packer_wmask format is undocumented; the chunk extracts every 8th bit as a byte strobe. It is unclear why the bits are spaced 8 apart and whether this correctly represents a byte-write mask.
uncertain_points.risk: Misinterpretation of packer_wmask may lead to incorrect strobe generation, causing the FIFO to write erroneous byte lanes or mask intended writes.
